newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates close lower on full reserves.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates close lower on full reserves.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates dropped on Monday as many banks filled reserves on Friday, before the end of the reserve period, dealers said.
The rates finished at 22.75, down from Friday's close of 23.125.
"The banks which believed the market would be tight this week, overfilled their reserves on Friday, and now they don't take up money," Takarekbank's Istvan Zsoter said.
Dealers added that last week's tax-payments also pushed the rates up, but the overnight rates had now returned to their usual levels.
"I think the rates will stay here or move a little downwards before the end of the period, though it is not easy to predict now," said Hypo-Bank's Zoltan Kalman.
The two-week reserve period will end on Tuesday.
